Byl zde [návštěvou?] můj bratr se svým [švagrem?]. [Odjeli?] do [Kosové Hory?] a před [svátky?] opět [přijedu / přijedou?]. [Jak?] dlouho zdržíš se na svátcích? passages.proposed_english: Warm [thanks?] for the dear [card?] from [Pelhřimov?]. [On?] your return you surely received both my [cards?]? I will send a letter as soon as possible. My brother was here [visiting?] with his [brother-in-law?]. They [went?] to [Kosová Hora?] and before the [holidays?], [I will come again / they will come again?]. [How?] long will you stay for the holidays? Wishing you very many pleasant moments at home, and warmly kissing you, yours [closing mark unclassified].
